extraction.name: Common Corpus
extraction.description: An open multilingual dataset for LLM pre-training, assembled from uncopyrighted or permissively licensed sources and containing about two trillion tokens. It includes a wide variety of languages, domains, time periods, and a large portion of code data.
extraction.creator: Pierre-Carl Langlais, Carlos Rosas Hinostroza, Mattia Nee, Catherine Amett, Pavel Chizhov, Eliot Krzystof Jones, Irène Girard, David Mach, Anastasia Stasenko, Ivan P. Yamshchikov, PleIAs
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Finance Commons combines multiple datasets with provenance details provided for each part. The SEC annual reports were compiled from EDGAR using the EDGAR-Crawler toolkit, with entries up to 2020 compiled by Loukas et al. (2021) and reports from 2021-2024 added from EDGAR. Other components were collected from sources such as the USPTO, UN Digital Library, EU websites, OECD, and open culture initiatives; some subsets were curated using APIs or existing corpora.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: SEC annual reports (Form 10-K) from EDGAR; documents from the USPTO; texts from the UN Digital Library; datasets from EU websites; OECD data; digitized books/newspapers from sources such as Chronicling America, Europeana, Gallica, Biblioteca, and the Library of Congress Selected Digitized Books Collection.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: SEC annual reports from 1993 to 2024; USPTO actions from 2019 to 2022; US PD Newspapers published between 1690 and 1963; Europeana Newspapers published between 1618 and 1990; German PD Newspapers published between 1794 and 1957.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The corpus has uneven language coverage, with shallow coverage for low-resource languages; the authors also note an "open data paradox" meaning it does not collect the whole range of available open data.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Not suitable for task-specific fine-tuning because it lacks instruction-tuning and specialized-task data; larger models will require much more data; curation is not perfectly accurate and may contain OCR errors or other issues, though metadata allows filtering.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Presented as open-science infrastructure for LLM research and development, intended to serve the public interest and support ethical fine-tuning datasets.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: PII removal is mentioned as part of curation, but the paper does not specify which sensitive human attributes are collected as dataset fields.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Used for pre-training of limited-size models; not directly suitable for task-specific fine-tuning; can support creation of ethical fine-tuning datasets; data has been used in numerous LLM projects.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The corpus is being actively expanded, with ongoing collection of more European-language data and planned enlargement in African languages; future collection of permissible data is encouraged. No explicit deprecation policy is stated.
